skills.delivery_notes: Five-hit melee flurry per click, commitment-locked until all hits complete. Physical weapon-scaled. First strike targets clicked enemy; further strikes can hit adjacent if target dies. Physical rule: element-neutral. econ-recrawl verified: 2 mana fixed cost per use (spend/steady-mana).
Always-on aura: party-wide physical damage, attack speed, and attack rating boost. No reservation (d2 aura free-toggle). §A row 2: aura-pulse geometry + self_buff.
Active self-buff: maximizes block rate and defense rating. Toggle/maintained.
